heading: I am Collin Thoman
subtitle: IT Leader · Tinkerer · Amateur Radio Operator
bio: Technology is both my career and my passion. With 12+ years in IT — from hands-on engineering to leading teams — I'm always learning and building, whether it's enterprise infrastructure, Home Assistant automations, a private cloud, or this blog (built with Claude Code as a proof of concept). When I'm not behind a keyboard, you'll find me overlanding in the Pacific Northwest, volunteering with emergency communications, or hosting board game nights.
